goal: A black-and-white dog with a wagging tail runs on the grass in the same sunny meadow; Mia (drawn young, about five years old) points at it and smiles. No letters, words, or numbers anywhere.
colorPrompt: Compose one children's book picture from the element pictures. Picture 1 shows the girl Mia: the four 3D views at the bottom are the approved character, and the flat drawing at the top is only a hint, so copy the 3D look; ignore the gray background, the labels, and the shadow. Picture 2 is the empty sunny meadow: green grass, a low wooden fence of light-brown posts and two rails across the back at the left and the middle, one low round green tree with a thick trunk and one low branch that reaches to the right, a small round pond with stones and two round lily pads at the right, tall green grass clumps at the lower left and lower right, ONE sun in the upper right, two small clouds, and a blue sky; use it as the background and keep the same meadow; the sun stays the only sun, so draw no second sun. Picture 3 shows the black-and-white dog with a white face blaze, white chest, white paws, a white tail tip, black ears, and black eye patches; draw ONE dog, exactly this dog (it is not golden-brown). Keep the soft, round, bright 3D render look of the pictures, not a 2D drawing and no outlines. The children keep their chibi proportions: a big head and a small body. Hands are small, clean hands with five clear short fingers (four fingers and one thumb) when open, never fists unless stated, and a hanging hand shows relaxed, separate short fingers. Rendering errors to NOT copy from the character pictures: a tiny dark tick mark or pale skin flap at the outer corner of an eye, and a faint pale crease on a forehead. Each eye ends in a smooth, rounded corner; no character here has an eyelash flick. Clean eye corners, no streak on the forehead, no marks on the face. The ears are smooth, with one clean rounded rim. Each piece of clothing is one even color with no pale patches, no pale blotches at the shoulders, and no stains. Do not change anyone's skin tone, hair, or clothes. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no writing on any picture or sign. The picture is for young children and is rated G. Keep each character exactly as in the pictures: Mia: a five-year-old girl with a chibi look (a big head and a small body), light-brown shoulder-length hair with a small pink bow on the side, big brown eyes, a pink T-shirt, blue denim overalls, white shoes. The picture: Mia points at the black-and-white dog that runs on the grass and smiles. A medium-wide shot at a low camera height in the sunny meadow (picture 2), the whole body of Mia in view. Mia stands at the left of the picture, turned about three quarters toward the right, smiles a big smile, and points with the index finger of one hand at the dog; her other hand hangs relaxed. The ONE black-and-white dog (picture 3) runs on the green grass at the right of the picture toward Mia, mid-run with all four legs in a running pose, its mouth open in a happy smile, and its tail up and wagging. Exactly one girl and one dog; the dog is black and white, never golden-brown. Exactly the characters named here are in the picture, and no other person or animal. A character of the pictures that this description does not name must not appear. Every named character has a clear, whole, friendly face. The page text is "I can see a dog." and is context only: do not draw any text.
linePrompt: Picture 1 is a 3D-rendered children's book picture. Convert picture 1 to line art for a student book: thick, even black lines (about three times a normal outline), simple closed shapes that a 5-year-old can color, on pure white. No blush circles, no eyelash ticks, no hair strands, no shading, no gray, no texture lines, no text. Keep every shape in the same place and the same size. Draw each eye as a closed outline with a big solid black pupil (a filled black circle) inside it. Draw the mouth exactly as in picture 1: an open mouth stays an open mouth drawn as a closed outline, and a closed smile stays one curve. Draw each hand as a closed outline with each finger as a separate rounded shape. Each head of hair is one closed shape. The ear is one closed outline with at most one inner curve. No lines on the clothes other than the outline, the collar, the cuffs, the buttons, the straps, the stripes, and the pocket. No wrinkle lines on any face. Simplify the background: draw only a few large, simple, closed shapes (the ground line, each fence post and each fence rail as a closed shape, the pond as one closed oval with a few big closed stone shapes and each lily pad as one closed oval, the tree as one closed trunk shape with one closed cloud crown, the sun as one closed circle, one or two closed cloud shapes, and each clump of tall grass as one closed cloud-like tuft shape). No grass blades, no small leaves, no flowers, no hatching, no tick marks, no wood grain lines, no cloud details. Every outline is one closed line that never runs into a background line; no loose line ends anywhere. Every line inside an object ends on another line. Use few background shapes. Mia's hair is one closed shape and her pink bow is one closed shape; her overalls keep the two straps and the bib pocket as closed shapes. Each hand is one closed outline with five fingers drawn as separate rounded closed shapes (four fingers and one thumb). Each animal is one closed outline with no fur strands; each ear, tail, wing, and fin is a closed shape; each eye is one closed outline with a big solid black pupil. The dog keeps its black ears, its two black eye patches, its black back, and its white face blaze, chest, and paws as closed shapes. The sun is one closed circle; if it has rays, each ray is one pointed triangle with its wide base on the circle, never a round petal. Mia points at the puppy with the index finger of one hand and the other fingers curled, as in picture 1. The puppy has two open round eyes, each one closed outline with a big solid black pupil; no eye is drawn as a closed or winking curve.
